answer.summary: E2E job failed because the API container never became ready: /api/me stayed at HTTP 000 for 300s and Spring logged a fatal startup error on an UnsatisfiedDependency (bean wiring). The PR only bumps the Dockerfile base image (eclipse-temurin 25), so the cause is plausibly the change and a retry will likely repeat it. The excerpt is truncated and does not name the missing bean, so this is not fully confirmed.
